datasets.title: Earthquake impact mapping from drones in Sayapada, Chaurpati-0, Achham, Nepal (November 2022)
datasets.description: Earthquake impacts mapping in Nepal (Sayapada, Chaurpati-0, Achham) from GLOBHE Crowddroner. The dataset includes high-resolution actionable drone data showing the area impacted from the earthquakes of early November 2022. lineage.description: High-resolution drone imagery was collected by GLOBHE Crowddroner over earthquake-impacted areas in Achham district, Nepal following the November 2022 seismic event. Orthomosaic and panoramic imagery were processed to document building damage and ground-level impacts. The dataset provides direct observational evidence of earthquake impacts for damage assessment and humanitarian response.
